source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of analysing market data (PDF 213-214).

items: Rujhan aur andaaz: survey dikhata hai ke bakery ki zyada khareedari weekend par hoti hai, to promotions weekend par.
Market ke hisse: gahakon ko umar, aamdani ya aadat se baantna; jawan meethi pastries, bare whole-grain roti pasand karte hain.
Muqabileen ka tajziya: harifon ki khoobiyan, qeematein aur raye dekhna; agar qareebi bakery artisanal roti ke liye mashhoor hai to gourmet pastries ya mausami cakes pesh karein.
Predictive analysis: purane data se andaza; musalsal barhti talab paidawar barhane ka ishara.
Data par faisle: data se products, qeematein aur marketing chunna; kam chalne wala product band karna.

blocks.text: Digital platforms ne taleem bhi badli hai; adaptive learning platforms har student ki tarraqi ke mutabiq sabaq ki mushkil badalte hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Market insight karobari faislon par kaise asar dalti hai? Misalein dijiye (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: Yeh andaze ki jagah saboot deti hai. Rujhan waqt tay karte (weekend promotions); hisse products aur paigham banate (jawanon ke liye meethi pastries, baron ke liye whole-grain); muqabileen ka tajziya mumtaz hone ka raasta batata (harif ki artisanal roti ke saath gourmet pastries); pesh-goi paidawar ki rehnumai karti; aur kam sales ka data product band karne ki daleel ban sakta hai. Qeemat ki gunjaish ke surveys qeematein tay karte hain.

items: Data se rujhan, hisse, muqabil aur pesh-goi; phir faisla.
